# Proofly

Proofly is a social proof toolkit that helps boost website conversions by displaying real-time notifications of customer activities.

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/proofly/.

## Actions

- **Get Proofly Campaigns** (read-only): Retrieve all proofly campaigns.
- **Get Proofly User Info** (read-only): Retrieve general information of the authenticated user.
- **Get Activity Logs** (read-only): Retrieve activity logs of the user.
